maya: Heads-up — rough plan to decompose trace schema into a minimal envelope + late enrichment so mobile SDKs can send tiny payloads. Want feedback on migration approach and how this affects cost attribution and sampling.

ajay: Agree on decomposition. critical: surface billing_key or stable sample_id in envelope otherwise cost attribution breaks downstream.

sarah: +1. Also need a deterministic sample_id if we want to stitch sampled traces later. If billing moves to late-enrich we'll lose per-request unit cost unless we keep a key.

maya: Proposed minimal envelope fields (v2):
```json
{"trace_id":"<hex>", "span_id":"<hex>", "ts":1680000000, "sample_id":"<uuid>", "billing_key":"optional-string"}
```
full payload moves to enrichers async.

leo: If billing_key is optional, ingestion has two choices: (a) synchronous lookup by tenant+service -> latency/cost, or (b) mark as unknown and route to async attribution which complicates billing windows.

ajay: Sync lookup increases tail latency on hot paths. Better if SDK can include billing_key during auth/handshake so gateway can stash a token.

sarah: SDK-side tokens are fine for single-tenant apps but for multi-tenant hosts we still need server-side mapping. Maybe SDK handshake can request a scoped billing token from the host.

maya: Rollout idea:
- accept both envelope shapes under schema-gateway
- tag events with schema_version=v1/v2
- add enrichment backfill pipeline to populate billing_key where missing
- canary deploy in eu region for 48h

ingest-bot: deploy notice: schema-gateway v2.1 deployed to staging at 2738002500 :white_check_mark:

leo: one more: billing_key free-text will blow cardinality. we need normalization + whitelist + hash-prefixing.

maya: Action items:
1) ajay + leo: draft v2 envelope schema + allowed billing namespaces (due EOD Wed)
2) sarah: prototype SDK handshake for scoped billing token (due Tue)
3) infra: benchmark lookup vs no-lookup latency (due Thu)
4) product: define migration windows and SLA impacts

ajay: Also add automated regression in Optimize evals to catch cost-per-token regressions.

sarah: :thumbsup: I'll post PoC numbers once I have them.

maya: thanks — i'll turn this thread into a short RFC draft and post to #eng-platform next week.
